// Fixture generator for #1196: writes real schema-v7 session bundles with
// master's own save path (native engine, LooperRepository, chainsFromLooper,
// SessionRepository.save, PedalBindingSet.encode). Not part of master.
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:looper_repository/looper_repository.dart';
import 'package:pedal_repository/pedal_repository.dart';
import 'package:segno/control/binding/fx_binding_target.dart';
import 'package:segno/control/binding/pedal_binding.dart';
import 'package:segno/control/binding/pedal_binding_set.dart';
import 'package:segno/session/session_mapping.dart';
import 'package:segno_engine/segno_engine.dart' show PumpedNativeEngine;
import 'package:session_repository/session_repository.dart';

void main() {
  final out = Platform.environment['FIXTURE_OUT']!;
  late PumpedNativeEngine engine;
  late LooperRepository looper;
  late SessionRepository session;
  Timer? pumpDriver;

  setUp(() {
    engine = PumpedNativeEngine();
    looper = LooperRepository(engine: engine)
      ..startEngine(
        const EngineConfig(
          sampleRate: 48000,
          inputChannels: 2,
          outputChannels: 2,
          maxLoopFrames: 48000,
        ),
      );
    session = SessionRepository(engine: engine);
    pumpDriver = Timer.periodic(
      const Duration(milliseconds: 1),
      (_) => engine.pump(frames: 0),
    );
  });

  tearDown(() async {
    pumpDriver?.cancel();
    await looper.dispose();
  });

  void take(int channel, int frames, double input) {
    looper.record(channel: channel);
    engine.pump(frames: frames, input: input);
    looper.record(channel: channel);
    engine.pump(frames: 0);
  }

  void overdub(int channel, int frames, double input) {
    looper.record(channel: channel);
    engine.pump(frames: frames, input: input);
    looper.record(channel: channel);
    engine.pump(frames: 2048);
  }

  test('v7 full session', () async {
    looper
      ..setSyncTempo(on: false)
      ..setTimeSignature(3, 4)
      ..setLooperMode(LooperMode.sync)
      ..crownPrimary(channel: 0)
      // Track 0: two lanes, an overdub (one undo layer).
      ..setLaneCount(channel: 0, count: 2)
      ..setLaneInput(channel: 0, lane: 1, inputChannel: 1);
    engine.pump(frames: 0);
    take(0, 2400, 0.25);
    overdub(0, 2400, 0.125);
    // Track 1: twice the base loop, then muted and turned down.
    take(1, 4800, 0.5);
    // Track 2: a take whose last overdub is undone (one redo layer).
    take(2, 2400, 0.75);
    overdub(2, 2400, 0.0625);
    looper.undo(channel: 2);
    engine.pump(frames: 2048);
    looper
      ..setLaneVolume(0.5, channel: 1, lane: 0)
      ..setLaneMute(muted: true, channel: 1, lane: 0)
      ..setLaneOutput(channel: 0, lane: 1, mask: 0x1)
      ..setLaneVolume(1.5, channel: 0, lane: 1)
      ..setLaneEffects(
        channel: 0,
        lane: 0,
        effects: [
          BuiltInEffect(
            type: TrackEffectType.delay,
            params: const [0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0],
          ),
          BuiltInEffect(type: TrackEffectType.reverb),
        ],
      )
      ..setLaneChainEnabled(channel: 0, lane: 1, enabled: false)
      ..setLaneEffects(
        channel: 0,
        lane: 1,
        effects: [BuiltInEffect(type: TrackEffectType.drive)],
      )
      ..setTrackEffects(
        channel: 1,
        effects: [BuiltInEffect(type: TrackEffectType.tremolo)],
      )
      ..setMasterEffects(
        effects: [BuiltInEffect(type: TrackEffectType.filter)],
      )
      ..setMonitorInputMode(input: 0, mode: MonitorMode.auto)
      ..setMonitorOutput(input: 0, mask: 0x3)
      ..setMonitorVolume(input: 0, volume: 1.5)
      ..setMonitorEffects(
        input: 0,
        effects: [BuiltInEffect(type: TrackEffectType.echo)],
      )
      ..setMonitorInputMode(input: 1, mode: MonitorMode.on)
      ..setMonitorOutput(input: 1, mask: 0x2)
      ..setMonitorVolume(input: 1, volume: 0.75)
      ..setMonitorMute(input: 1, muted: true)
      ..setTempo(100)
      ..setTimeSignature(3, 4)
      ..setQuantizeDiv(GridDivision.bar)
      ..setClickMode(ClickMode.rec)
      ..setClickOutput(0x2)
      ..setClickVolume(0.8)
      ..setCountIn(2)
      ..crownPrimary(channel: 0)
      ..setOneShot(channel: 2, oneShot: true)
      ..setOneShot(channel: 5, oneShot: true)
      ..setTrackLengthPreset(channel: 1, bars: 2);
    engine.pump(frames: 256);

    final bindings = PedalBindingSet([
      PedalBinding(
        key: const PedalBindingKey(button: PedalButton.track1, bank: 0),
        target: const FxChainTarget(
          FxAddress(stage: FxStage.loop, lane: 0),
        ).canonicalString(),
      ),
      PedalBinding(
        key: const PedalBindingKey(button: PedalButton.track2, bank: 0),
        target: const FxChainTarget(
          FxAddress(stage: FxStage.master),
        ).canonicalString(),
        behavior: BindingBehavior.momentary,
      ),
    ]).encode();

    final dir = '$out/v7_master_full';
    final saved = await session.save(
      dir,
      chains: chainsFromLooper(looper),
      pedalBindings: bindings,
    );
    // ignore: avoid_print
    print(saved.toJson());
  });

  test('v7 settings-only session', () async {
    looper
      ..setLaneEffects(
        channel: 3,
        lane: 0,
        effects: [BuiltInEffect(type: TrackEffectType.octaver)],
      )
      ..setMonitorInputMode(input: 1, mode: MonitorMode.on)
      ..setOneShot(channel: 4, oneShot: true);
    engine.pump(frames: 0);
    final dir = '$out/v7_master_empty';
    await session.save(dir, chains: chainsFromLooper(looper));
  });
}
